basis: Predeclared revisable source-review criteria; not an absolute gold set

negative-force.a: registration duty must; retain staff exception if linked
negative-force.c: tool prohibition must_not with maintenance exception retained
negative-force.d: this-policy non-prohibition not absence of duty or universal permission
negative-force.f: non-applicability of a ban, not absence of duty

baggage: Non-prohibition of ammunition and non-applicability of paragraph a must not be called absence of a duty to carry weapons. The neutral statement mapping is the tested profile choice, not the only conceivable legal representation.
Unloaded-firearm statement itself retains declaration recipient, content, unloaded status, timing, oral/written alternatives and all conjunctive conditions.
Logical evidence selects complete relevant list, not just unless or one branch.
Guardrails: paragraph b stays limited to weapons and paragraph a; loaded firearms, explosives, checked scope, ammunition reference remain.
photos: Hairstyle permission retains good-likeness condition in both scope_text and statement.
Certificate caution identifies certificate types in statement itself.
Guardrails: recommendation remains should, replacement scope not infant-only, head support/tilt and reuse meaning retained; examples do not become obligations.
leave: Nonconsecutive-months proviso survives in statement AND scope_text, with governing passages as scope support.
Guardrails: eligibility conjunction, seven-or-more versus more-than-seven, USERRA/rehire alternatives, absence counting, payroll week and 52 weeks, uniform discretionary recognition remain.
